# https://designyourinvention.com/ llms.txt

# Design Your Invention (DYI)

> Design Your Invention is an intellectual property management software (IPMS)
> platform for pharma companies and IP boutique law firms. It combines
> multi-jurisdiction patent docketing, prior art search across 100+ jurisdictions
> (EPO), and AI-assisted patent drafting for 6 jurisdictions (US, EP, IN, WO, JP, CN),
> on a compliance-ready architecture that mirrors FDA 21 CFR Part 11 standards.

## Core pages
- [What is DYI](https://designyourinvention.com/): Overview, category, and who it is for.
- [Patent Docketing](https://designyourinvention.com/docketing/): Multi-jurisdiction docketing, PCT/PRV/NPE case management, fees, and deadlines.
- [Patent Search](https://designyourinvention.com/patent-search/): Prior art search across 100+ jurisdictions via EPO.
- [AI Patent Drafting](https://designyourinvention.com/ai-patent-drafting/): AI-assisted first drafts for attorney review across 6 jurisdictions.
- [DYI vs legacy IPMS](https://designyourinvention.com/compare/): Positioning against incumbent IP management platforms.
- [FAQ](https://designyourinvention.com/faq/): Common questions about the platform, jurisdictions, and compliance.

## About
- For: pharma companies and IP boutique law firms.
- Filing coverage: US and PCT first, then EU, JP, CN; India as a primary customer geography.
- Compliance: compliance-ready architecture mirroring 21 CFR Part 11 standards (not certified).
- Architecture: multi-tenant with per-tenant data isolation.

## Notes for citation
- AI-generated patent drafts are a starting point for attorney review, not filing-ready output.
- Pricing is not public yet; contact the company for current pricing.
- No customer logos, testimonials, or third-party certifications are claimed at this time.
